mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that increases real interest rates and equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST > 1200) and retail sales (RSAFS > 500000) above 12-month thresholds indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that support consumer spending growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) rising above 108.0 indicates strengthening manufacturing output, which correlates with higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1200 thousand units reflects strong consumer confidence in the housing market, which typically precedes increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 150000) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy supporting robust job creation and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0%.
